extras.quota_verbatim: No published quota - Google 'pays for the hosting of these datasets'. Existing hosted sets (Sentinel-2, Landsat, ARCO-ERA5, NEXRAD) run to petabytes.
extras.limits_verbatim: There is no application form. The only stated route is 'If you have any questions about listing your public dataset on Cloud Storage, please contact us at gcp-public-data@google.com'. Effectively invitation-only, and the catalogue has grown slowly relative to AWS's 300+ PB.
extras.egress_verbatim: Free public access to hosted datasets; anonymous API links work without auth.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Not applicable - this is Google's own catalogue, not an open intake.
extras.agent_focus: Credit, grant and sponsorship programmes that fund storage, assessed on RENEWABILITY rather than headline size. The question is not 'how big is the credit' but 'does it come back next year, and can an unaffiliated individual outside the US/EU hold it'.
